scripts.docker:build: docker-compose build --no-cache && docker-compose run --rm mriviewer-app bash e2e-tests/app_prepare.sh && docker-compose run --rm mriviewer-autotests bash test_prepare.sh && docker-compose down
scripts.docker:test: docker-compose run --rm mriviewer-autotests bash test_run.sh $test && docker-compose down
scripts.docker:test:update: docker-compose run --rm mriviewer-autotests bash test_update.sh $test && docker-compose down
